subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should OpenClaw restore the shipped Discord elevated fallback from `channels.discord.allowFrom`, or confirm explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` as the current security contract?
rationale: The latest release documented the fallback, but current main removed that promise and elevated host exec authorization is security-sensitive.

options.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
options.body: Implement Discord's fallback through the existing channel plugin adapter, preserve explicit-empty denial, and update runtime, diagnostics, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Require explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Treat the current docs as the intended contract, close this issue with release-note-quality rationale, and keep diagnostics focused on `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord`.

recommendation.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
recommendation.body: Implement Discord's fallback through the existing channel plugin adapter, preserve explicit-empty denial, and update runtime, diagnostics, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both the current docs correction and the channel-seam history that define where this fallback would belong.
